title: AutoDrop Manager
description: Automatically drops selected items when they enter your inventory
body:
# 📥 AutoDrop Manager [Fabric 1.21.1]

**AutoDrop Manager** is a lightweight, client-side mod designed to automatically keep your inventory clean from unwanted trash. Tired of cobbles, dirt, gravel, or diorite clogging up your slots while strip-mining or excavating? This mod does all the tedious inventory cleaning for you instantly!

---

### 📺 Video Showcase & Tutorial
> Watch the mod in action and learn how to set it up in less than a minute!<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/2pF2gu25ZD8" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>![menu for this mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/256830723a39ccf1cf7d7a9f1eff45e863b73249_0.webp)


---

### ✨ Features

* **Smart Item Filter:** Easily select any block or item from the entire game using a clean grid layout.
* **Instant Auto-Dropping:** As soon as a blacklisted item enters your inventory, the mod drops it on the ground immediately.
* **Responsive Search Bar:** Quickly search for blocks and items by their localized names or technical IDs.
* **Effortless Management:** Features a global **ON/OFF** toggle switch and a **Clear** button to wipe your blacklist in one click.
* **Full Keybind Support:** Change the menu opening key to any button you prefer inside the standard Minecraft Controls menu.

---

### 🛠 How to Use

1. Go to Minecraft **Options -> Controls -> Key Binds** and assign a comfortable key for **"Open Mod Menu"** (Default is `O`).
2. Press the assigned key in-game to open the custom interface.
3. Use the search text box to find the items you want to get rid of.
4. **Click on an item in the grid** — a red highlight will appear. This means the item is now blacklisted.
5. Make sure the toggle button at the top right is set to **ON**.
6. That's it! The blacklisted trash will no longer stay in your inventory.
